note: Every Donate button opens that organisation's own page. FloodAssist Assam does not collect or route money.

channels.name: Bondhu Streams — Assam Flood Relief
channels.organization: Bondhu Streams × Dhiman Streams × Daden Group
channels.summary: Initiative by Bondhu Streams × Dhiman Streams × Daden Group — Assam flood relief with a live public donation ledger.
channels.howTo: Open their Assam Flood Relief page and use Donate for Assam. The live ledger updates as contributions come in.

channels.name: National Disaster Response Fund (NDRF)
channels.organization: Ministry of Home Affairs · Government of India
channels.summary: Central government disaster response fund. CarryMinati's Assam flood charity stream directed viewers here via BharatKosh.
channels.howTo: Open BharatKosh → Quick Payment → Ministry: Home Affairs → Purpose: Contributions/Grants to NDRF.

account.name: Contributions / Grants to NDRF
account.bank: State Bank of India, Central Secretariat Branch, New Delhi

channels.name: PM CARES Fund
channels.organization: Prime Minister's Office, Government of India
channels.summary: National emergency relief fund for distress situations. Accepts domestic and foreign donations with 80G tax exemption.
channels.howTo: Donate online on pmcares.gov.in, or use UPI / bank transfer with the details below.

account.name: PM CARES
account.bank: State Bank of India, New Delhi Main Branch

channels.name: Goonj — Rahat Floods
channels.summary: NGO delivering essential relief material to families in Assam and other flood-hit states through the Rahat Floods campaign.

channels.name: SEEDS India — Flood Response
channels.summary: Emergency kits and transitional shelters for flood-affected communities in Assam, including Jorhat and Cachar.

channels.name: Rapid Response — Assam Floods
channels.summary: Disaster relief NGO active in Assam since 2016 — food packets, dry ration, hygiene kits, and medical camps.

channels.name: Assam Foundation of North America
channels.summary: Volunteer foundation supporting Upper Assam flood relief through FCRA-registered partners — groceries, medical aid, and emergency supplies.

inKindNote: Donating supplies (dry ration, hygiene kits, tarpaulin, etc.) is coordinated by ASDMA. Call toll-free 1077 before sending anything — unsolicited perishables slow relief.
